findings.problem: Completed-entry cancellation submits a new cleanup worker without protecting synchronous executor submission failure. RuntimeError/BrokenThreadPool replaces the exact initiating CancelledError before an exit Future or observation callback exists.
findings.remedy: Retain the original cancellation and exact submission failure using the established concrete failure policy; define and test the resource-owner disposition when no cleanup worker can be submitted. Add a bounded completed-entry-before-delivery/rejected-submission contract, without silently blocking the event loop.

findings.problem: Worker acquisition/state updates run directly into final output return.
findings.remedy: Add one paragraph break before return future.
